context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 289 fully tested. Brand Voice Studio working correctly. Key endpoints: GET /api/brand-voice/profile/{property_id} (auto-seeds default profile), POST /api/brand-voice/profile/{property_id} (upserts), GET /api/brand-voice/purposes (11 purposes), POST /api/brand-voice/generate (creates text + stores in history), POST /api/brand-voice/preview (generates without saving), GET /api/brand-voice/history/{property_id} (with purpose filter and limit). Frontend panel at 'Marka Sesi Stüdyosu' in SYSTEM section. GPT-4o-mini via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY produces high-quality Turkish text. Fixed duplicate Megaphone import in App.js.

endpoints: GET /api/brand-voice/profile/{property_id} - auto-seeds default profile (tone=warm_luxury, 4 traits, 3 dos, 3 donts, 2 samples, sign_off, language=tr)
POST /api/brand-voice/profile/{property_id} - upserts allowed fields (tone, personality_traits, dos, donts, sample_sentences, sign_off, language)
GET /api/brand-voice/purposes - returns 11 purposes with id, label, system_addition, max_words
POST /api/brand-voice/generate - creates text in brand voice, stores in brand_voice_history collection
POST /api/brand-voice/preview - generates without persisting (for live editing)
GET /api/brand-voice/history/{property_id} - returns last N generations with purpose filter
purposes_catalog: video_prompt - Sora 2 Video Üretimi için Prompt

panel_elements: Turkish UI: 'Marka Sesi Stüdyosu', 'BRAND VOICE STUDIO'
Left column: Profile editor with tone input, ListField for traits/dos/donts/samples, sign-off textarea, 'Profili Kaydet' button
Right column: Purpose dropdown (11 options), context textarea, 'Önizle' button, 'Üret & Kaydet' button
Output shows in styled box (rose for generate, stone for preview)
interactions_tested: Personality traits can be added via Enter key or + button
Traits can be removed via X button

fixes_applied.issue: Duplicate Megaphone import causing 'Identifier has already been declared' compilation error
fixes_applied.fix: Removed duplicate Megaphone import on line 207

notes: Brand Voice Studio uses GPT-4o-mini via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY for text generation. The LLM produces high-quality Turkish text that follows the brand voice profile rules (tone, traits, dos/donts). If LLM fails, there's a template fallback. Preview generates without saving to history, while Generate saves to brand_voice_history collection.
